package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
)

var requestDuration = prometheus.NewHistogramVec(prometheus.HistogramOpts{
	Name: "http_request_duration_seconds",
	Help: "Duration of HTTP requests",
}, []string{"path", "user_id", "email"})

// scenario for prometheus_high_cardinality_labels: `counter.WithLabelValues(userId)` or `histogram.WithLabelValues(requestPath)` where label values appear to come from user IDs, request paths, or other high-cardinality sources
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func TrackRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := r.Header.Get("X-User-ID")
	email := r.Header.Get("X-User-Email")
	requestDuration.WithLabelValues(r.URL.Path, userID, email).Observe(0.05)

	requestCounter := prometheus.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{
		Name: "api_requests",
		Help: "API request count",
	}, []string{"user_id"})
	requestCounter.WithLabelValues(userID).Inc()

	w.Write([]byte("tracked"))
}
